entity.name: Abhijot Singh (Plexescor)
entity.description: 16-year-old self-taught systems developer from Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, India. Writing software since age 13, focused on native C++, Linux internals, and compiler design. Solo maintainer of HPR and the HPR extension ecosystem. Also building Tantrums, a compiled language with an LLVM backend.

projects.name: HPR Human Pattern Recorder
projects.description: A compiled, offline, zero-account activity tracker for Linux (Wayland/X11) and Windows. Built in C++23 with an 8-27MB RAM footprint, sandboxed Lua 5.4 extension engine with function overriding API, native browser and IDE project tracking without extensions, cross-day pattern analysis across 9 metrics, and a community extension registry called HPR Store. 450+ organic downloads across Linux and Windows in under 4 months. No telemetry by default, no cloud, no account required.

plans.name: HPR Round 1 Infrastructure and Ecosystem
plans.description: Infrastructure and ecosystem grant. Budget: monitor Rs 12000, keyboard Rs 2200, mouse Rs 1000, code signing cert Rs 6500, VPS 1yr Rs 5000, domain Rs 2000, GST buffer Rs 1300, maintainer stipend Rs 10000. Total Rs 40000. Milestones: domain migration, blog post, Windows code signing, 5+ HPR Store extensions, 3 new first-party extensions. All within 7 weeks.
